en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. The image shows dense clusters of 3–4 story masonry buildings with steep gabled roofs and several church-like structures with towers and spires. In the foreground there is a railway line with multiple tracks, small station or industrial buildings, and a few trains. Behind the town are patchwork fields, tree-covered hills, and a forested ridge in the distance. There is no visible border or printed caption on the front side.
